_: What to SAY to the generator for a UI ICON, one row per id. `tools/art/icon.mts` reads it and `portrait.mts <id> <png> 48 icons` puts the result in `src/render/generated-icons.ts`, which `skillIcon` and `categoryIcon` merge OVER their hand-drawn grids.
_how: An icon is read at 24-40px in a socket, so: ONE object, centred, filling the frame, hard silhouette, no scene and no ground. Asked at 64 and shipped at 48.
_inks: Lamplit stone, oiled timber and tarnished brass, with fire, frost, lightning and poison the ONLY saturated inks — so an element reads at socket size and everything else stays furniture.
how: A single ICON: ONE object centred and filling the frame, seen straight on, BOLD readable silhouette with a hard dark outline, chunky shapes and few colours, dramatic lighting off the object itself. NOT a scene, NOT a landscape, NOT a character, NOT a background, NOT text, NOT a border, NOT a frame, NOT multiple objects. Transparent background.
